tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product variant to the cart by its priceLookUpNumber (from search_products or get_product_details). Returns the updated cart.

quantity.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: apply_offer_code
tools.description: Apply a discount/offer code to the cart, or remove the current one by omitting offerCode. Returns the updated cart.

offerCode.description: The offer code to apply. Omit to remove the applied code.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Get the current shopping cart: rows with quantities and prices, totals, fees, discounts and any applied offer code.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get the details of one product by its productNumber: description, variants (sizes/colors) with prices, stock status and the priceLookUpNumber needed by add_to_cart.

productNumber.description: The product's productNumber, as returned by search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the store's product catalogue with a free-text query (product name, brand, category or keywords). Returns matching products with price, stock status, URL and the productNumber to pass to get_product_details for variants and the priceLookUpNumber needed by add_to_cart.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set the quantity of a cart row (rowId from get_cart). A quantity of 0 removes the row. Returns the updated cart.

rowId.description: The cart row to update, as returned by get_cart.

quantity.description: The new quantity for the row. 0 removes the row.
